mapper.sql: left join lateral (select a.ack_id, a.ack_seq, a.ack_status, a.ack_on from srm_po_ack a where a.po_id = p.po_id and a.rev = p.rev order by a.ack_seq desc limit 1) va on true

p.po_id, p.po_no, p.rev, p.po_date, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, p.status, p.issued_at, p.currency_cd, trim_scale(p.total_amt)::text as total_amt, p.row_ver, (select count(*) from srm_po_line l where l.po_id = p.po_id) as line_cnt, va.ack_seq, va.ack_status, va.ack_on, (p.issued_at at time zone #{zone})::date + #{dueDays} as ack_due_date

from srm_po p join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = p.cust_id
where p.po_date between #{c.from} and #{c.to} and p.issued_at is not null
and p.status in ('ISSUED', 'ACKED') and p.status in ('ISSUED', 'ACKED') and (va.ack_id is null or va.ack_status = 'REJECTED') and p.status in ('ISSUED', 'ACKED') and va.ack_status in ('ACCEPTED', 'PARTIAL')
and (p.po_no ilike #{c.keywordLike} escape '\' or c.cust_cd ilike #{c.keywordLike} escape '\' or c.cust_nm ilike #{c.keywordLike} escape '\')

p.po_id, p.po_no, p.rev, p.po_date, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, p.status, p.issued_at, p.currency_cd, trim_scale(p.total_amt)::text as total_amt, p.row_ver, (select count(*) from srm_po_line l where l.po_id = p.po_id) as line_cnt, va.ack_seq, va.ack_status, va.ack_on, (p.issued_at at time zone #{c.zone})::date + #{c.dueDays} as ack_due_date
mapper.select:
select
order by p.po_date desc, p.po_id desc limit 2000

select
order by
p.po_no c.cust_nm p.issued_at is null, p.issued_at va.ack_status is null, va.ack_status p.status p.po_date
desc,
p.po_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}

select from srm_po p join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = p.cust_id
where p.po_id = #{poId}

select l.po_line_id, l.line_no, i.item_cd, l.item_nm, l.supplier_item_cd, l.unit_cd, trim_scale(l.qty)::text as qty, trim_scale(l.qty - l.cancel_qty - l.recv_qty)::text as open_qty, l.due_date, l.line_status, trim_scale(pr.qty)::text as promised_qty, pr.first_date as promised_first, pr.last_date as promised_last from srm_po_line l join srm_po p on p.po_id = l.po_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id
left join lateral (select sum(al.promised_qty) as qty, min(al.promised_date) as first_date, max(al.promised_date) as last_date from srm_po_ack_line al where al.ack_id = va.ack_id and al.po_line_id = l.po_line_id) pr on true where l.po_id = #{poId} order by l.line_no

select a.ack_id, a.ack_seq, a.rev, a.source, a.ack_status, a.reject_reason, a.ack_by_nm, a.ack_on, a.remark, a.created_at, a.created_by, (a.rev = p.rev and a.ack_seq = (select max(x.ack_seq) from srm_po_ack x where x.po_id = p.po_id and x.rev = p.rev)) as valid, a.rev < p.rev as old_rev from srm_po_ack a join srm_po p on p.po_id = a.po_id where a.po_id = #{poId} order by a.ack_seq desc

select al.ack_line_id, al.ack_id, al.po_line_id, l.line_no, i.item_cd, al.promised_date, trim_scale(al.promised_qty)::text as promised_qty, al.remark from srm_po_ack_line al join srm_po_ack a on a.ack_id = al.ack_id join srm_po_line l on l.po_line_id = al.po_line_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where a.po_id = #{poId} order by a.ack_seq desc, l.line_no, al.promised_date
select coalesce(max(ack_seq), 0) + 1 from srm_po_ack where po_id = #{poId}

insert into srm_po_ack (comp_cd, po_id, rev, ack_seq, source, ack_status, reject_reason, ack_by_nm, ack_on, remark, import_job_id, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{poId}, #{rev}, #{seq}, #{source}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{ackByNm}, #{ackOn}, #{remark}, #{jobId}, #{by}) returning ack_id
mapper.insert: insert into srm_po_ack_line (comp_cd, ack_id, po_line_id, promised_date, promised_qty, remark, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{ackId}, #{poLineId}, #{promisedDate}, #{promisedQty}, #{remark}, #{by})
mapper.select: select l.line_no, l.qty - l.cancel_qty - l.recv_qty as open_qty, coalesce(s.qty, 0) as promised, l.due_date, s.last_date from srm_po_ack a join srm_po_line l on l.po_id = a.po_id and l.line_status = 'OPEN' and l.qty - l.cancel_qty - l.recv_qty > 0 left join lateral (select sum(al.promised_qty) as qty, max(al.promised_date) as last_date from srm_po_ack_line al where al.ack_id = a.ack_id and al.po_line_id = l.po_line_id) s on true where a.ack_id = #{ackId} order by l.line_no
mapper.update: update srm_po_ack set ack_status = #{status} where ack_id = #{ackId} and ack_status <> #{status}
mapper.select: select po_line_id, line_no, unit_cd, qty - cancel_qty - recv_qty as open_qty, line_status from srm_po_line where po_id = #{poId} and line_no = #{lineNo}
order by x.due_date, x.po_no, x.line_no limit 2000

order by
x.po_no x.cust_nm x.line_no x.item_cd x.ack_status is null, x.ack_status x.promised_last is null, x.promised_last x.late_days is null, x.late_days x.due_date
desc,
x.po_line_id limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
